decision_cruda.rationale: Radio and CMMS agree that LH-01 (C512-10, likely 4 h) and LH-04 (E569-12, likely 2 h) are down, so CONFIRM-01 does not apply. LH-10 is in preventive maintenance until 14:00 and can't move. No stope is stopped, so no reserve can be activated. E569-12: 324 t broken, 83 t mucked, so 241 t left. A repaired LH-04 at 280 m mucks about 33 t/h. From 11:30 to 17:00 that is about 181 t, which leaves about 60 t in the stope that would not count. LH-08 is the cheapest loader to lend, since its heading is worth only 0.5 oz/h under DEV-COST-01. It is an LH410 and mucks about 23.6 t/h at 280 m. It takes about 0.6 h to get there. It would muck that remaining ore, worth about 60 t x 0.331 oz/t = about 20 oz. The cost is about 7 h x 0.5 = 3.5 oz, so the net is about 16 oz. The Este stockpile (114 of 450 t) has room, and the trucks keep up. C512-10: 136 t are left, and LH-01 can probably muck them after a 4 h repair, at about 40.8 t/h from 13:30. A loan there would gain little in the likely case, so I did not cover it. I also did not take LH-07 or LH-09, because their opportunity costs are higher.
